output.summary: KEP-603 proposes passing pod metadata (such as Pod name and namespace) to the CSI NodePublishVolume call when a CSI driver requires it. Its status is implemented, stage stable.
output.rationale: The design lets CSI drivers receive pod name and namespace during NodePublishVolume, formalizing a design proposal with missing details. The sources show the feature went through alpha, beta and GA targeting over several releases, with the feature gate and API changes tracked in kubernetes/kubernetes#73883. The sources do not explain the 2021 status change to implemented beyond the PR discussion about status conventions.

alternatives.option: Keep the original design proposal as the only document
alternatives.why_not: The readme says this KEP contains details that are missing from the design proposal, so the KEP was written to add them.

alternatives.option: Add a user-facing docs page on kubernetes.io
alternatives.why_not: Maintainers said the feature is not user facing and documentation would go in kubernetes-csi/docs instead.

alternatives.option: Track the API changes under separate KEPs (#557, #770)
alternatives.why_not: msau42 said the API changes for #557, #603, #770 and this one are all covered by kubernetes/kubernetes#73883, so they were combined in one PR.

evidence.quote: This KEP contains details that are missing from the design proposal.
The API changes for #557 #603 #770 and this are all covered by kubernetes/kubernetes#73883.
This feature is not user facing, so no docs are needed for kubernetes.io. We will, however, update developer docs for kubernetes-csi
Since we narrowly missed finishing this in 1.18, we are planning to get this feature done in 1.18.
https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/2867 retroactively declared this beta since that's where this ultimately ended up during 1.21.
